skill.description: Use 134 sourced principles to review SaaS conversion, onboarding, pricing, retention, dashboards, and positioning. Gambling, betting, and casino products are excluded.
skill.summary: Review SaaS design decisions using 12 reference themes covering customer value, activation, retention, and revenue.
skill.author: heliocosta-dev

security_audit.summary: All 149 static alerts are false positives involving documentation, repository-local assets, installation examples, or documented maintainer API authentication. Two semantic findings concern coercive retention advice and untrusted external posts sharing instructions in the optional drafting workflow. No evidence found of malware, unauthorized credential transmission, or an embedded attempt to override this audit.

remediation.issue: Retention guidance recommends data-loss pressure and organizational dependencies designed to obstruct leaving.
remediation.suggestion: Remove threatened benchmark loss and dependencies intended to obstruct departure. Preserve exports, simple cancellation, truthful notifications, and voluntary collaboration instead of addictive engagement loops.

remediation.issue: Optional distillation combines trusted instructions and external post text in one model message.
remediation.suggestion: Place the specification in trusted instructions and mark posts and images as untrusted data. Reject embedded commands, limit agent tools, and review drafts before merging.

semantic_findings.title: Coercive Retention Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The playbook recommends "sync in 24h or lose the weekly benchmark" and "negative churn by bureaucratic inertia". It advises variable rewards and dependencies intended to make departure require organizational coordination, encouraging pressured engagement and obstructed exit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The entry explicitly recommends threatened benchmark loss and organizational dependencies as retention mechanisms. These are harmful design recommendations, not evidence of deployed restrictions.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Posts Share the Distillation Instruction Context
semantic_findings.description: The updater combines its specification with external posts, then instructs the model to follow the message. Embedded instructions could contaminate drafts or redirect the assisted agent; human review only explicitly gates writing and merging.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code concatenates external content with instructions, and the documented assisted workflow passes that content to Claude Code. No evidence found of actual exploitation.

content.user_title: Review SaaS Conversion, Onboarding, and Pricing
content.value_statement: SaaS teams lose users when interfaces obscure value or create unnecessary effort. This sourced playbook guides design reviews across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization.
actual_capabilities: Guide landing-page reviews using customer awareness, proof, CTA clarity, contrast, and performance principles.
Review signup and checkout friction using field count, input choices, trust signals, and price transparency.
Plan onboarding around first value, activation behaviors, empty states, and time-to-value.
Compare pricing structures, trial models, upgrade timing, and customer acquisition economics.
Evaluate dashboard priorities, feature scope, customer positioning, and distribution bottlenecks.
Support recommendations with named mechanisms, original post links, and bundled visual examples.
limitations: Provides design guidance, not automatic implementation, analytics collection, or guaranteed revenue improvements.
Reflects curated posts through August 26, 2026; cited studies and practitioner claims still require contextual verification.
Repository usage terms require attribution and exclude gambling, betting, casino products, and real-money games of chance.
Optional maintenance requires external API access. Review retention tactics for coercion and generated drafts for untrusted instructions.

use_cases.title: Review Acquisition Messaging
use_cases.description: Assess a SaaS landing page against customer awareness, proof, and CTA clarity before planning measurable conversion changes.

use_cases.title: Shorten the Path to First Value
use_cases.description: Identify onboarding drop-offs and prioritize empty states, step order, and activation behaviors for a clearer first session.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Monetization Choices
use_cases.description: Compare pricing tiers and trial models using customer fit, cost to serve, acquisition cost, and retention.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Relevant Principle
prompt_templates.prompt: Our SaaS serves [customer group] and solves [problem]. Explain three relevant design principles. Cite their sources and suggest one small improvement for each.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner introduction to the reference library.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Landing Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this landing page: [copy or screenshot]. Our audience is [ICP], and traffic comes from [channel]. Rank issues by impact. Cite principles and propose measurable tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate conversion review with audience context.

prompt_templates.title: Redesign an Activation Journey
prompt_templates.prompt: Our onboarding steps are [steps], with drop-offs [rates] and first value [event]. Identify the largest bottleneck. Propose a revised sequence and activation metrics. Preserve compliance requirements and user control.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced onboarding diagnosis using funnel evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Monetization Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [pricing and trial options] using [ARPU, CAC, churn, activation, traffic, service costs]. State assumptions and compare full-funnel economics. Choose research or experimentation based on available volume. Define success metrics and validation requirements. Reject artificial scarcity, hidden billing, and obstructed cancellation. Cite relevant principles.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced cross-functional pricing and retention planning.

output_examples.input: Review a generic project-management landing page for small agency owners.
output: Issue: The headline names a software category but does not identify the agency problem.
Change: State the specific task and customer group, then show the product solving that task.
Principle: Test hero comprehension with a stranger from your ICP.
Measurement: Compare comprehension and signup completion using matched traffic sources.

output_examples.input: New trial users see an empty dashboard after a long setup form.
output: Hypothesis: Users leave before understanding the product's value.
Change: Show clearly labeled sample data and one action leading to a real result.
Principle: Never ship a blank dashboard.
Measurement: Track first useful action, time-to-value, and seven-day retention.

output_examples.input: Choose whether to require a payment card for a SaaS trial.
output: Compare visitor-to-trial, trial-to-paid, retained customers, and service costs for both models.
A higher trial-to-paid rate alone does not prove better economics.
Principle: Ask for the card in trial, but optimize for the right ICP.
Guardrail: Disclose billing clearly and preserve straightforward cancellation.

best_practices: Provide customer context, acquisition sources, product stage, and baseline metrics before requesting recommendations.
Preserve attribution and source citations. Validate proposed changes through suitable experiments or qualitative research.
Preserve informed consent, truthful claims, data portability, and easy cancellation when applying behavioral mechanisms.
anti_patterns: Copy competitor layouts without understanding customer needs, awareness, and proof requirements.
Treat anecdotal uplift figures or underpowered tests as guaranteed outcomes.
Use artificial urgency, hidden billing defaults, or exit barriers to increase retention.

faq.question: What does this skill contain?
faq.answer: It contains 134 design principles across 12 themes, with source links and visual examples.

faq.question: Does it build or modify my product automatically?
faq.answer: The core skill supplies guidance and references. Product implementation requires your agent, project context, and approval. Maintainer scripts stage updates separately.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The marketplace lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support. The repository packages the material as an Agent Skill.

faq.question: Does normal use require API keys?
faq.answer: Reading the reference library requires no credentials. Optional maintenance uses X authentication; automated drafting and ranking also require Anthropic access.

faq.question: Can it support gambling products?
faq.answer: No. The skill excludes gambling, betting, casino products, and real-money games of chance, including relevant loot-box mechanics.

faq.question: Are its recommendations guaranteed to improve revenue?
faq.answer: No. Verify evidence against your market and users. Review retention advice for coercion and updater drafts for untrusted instructions.
